searchText: A good way to conceptualize the deposit contract is as a one-way bridge to the consensus layer And withdrawals are a bridge back from consensus to execution, just that they happen without a tx And because of that don’t call a contract, either

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: A good way to conceptualize the deposit contract is as a one-way bridge to the consensus layer

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: And withdrawals are a bridge back from consensus to execution, just that they happen without a tx

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: And because of that don’t call a contract, either
